verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core documented model is a natural-language goal plus a starting URL, with the product running a browser that navigates unseen sites, fills forms and completes multi-step tasks through a REST run-tasks endpoint and SDKs. Hands-on community testing confirms it handles the happy path well (the Geico example). The same tester saw it fail to click a tab and a popup on costcotravel.com, so reliability on complex flows is mixed. missing for 10: reliable end-to-end completion on complex or unfamiliar flows (hands-on evidence shows failures on popups and tabs), independent benchmark or success-rate data.
